title: 12 of the best new K-dramas to watch in November 2026 - South China Morning Post
text:
12 of the best new K-dramas to watch in November 2026, including The Blue Road on Netflix | South China Morning Post K-drama - K-drama 12 of the best new K-dramas to watch in November 2026 Advertisement K-drama news K-drama K-drama 12 of the best new K-dramas to watch in November 2026, including The Blue Road on Netflix 
 From fantasies, romcoms and comedies to police, courtroom and school dramas, there is something for every K-drama fan to enjoy in November
 3 -MIN READ 3 -MIN Listen Pierce Conran in Seoul Published: 9:15pm, 30 Oct 2026 November promises to be a remarkably busy month for K-drama fans, offering a wealth of choices that include the year’s biggest fantasy epic and two sequel seasons to recent hits.
 Here is what to watch over the coming month.
 1. The Remarried Empress
 Lead cast: Shin Min-a, Ju Ji-hoon, Lee Jong-suk, Lee Se-young
 The Remarried Empress | Main Trailer | Disney+ Singapore November’s splashiest show is undoubtedly the big-budget adaptation of the fantasy romance webtoon The Remarried Empress . Shin Min-a plays Navier, the beautiful empress of the Eastern Empire, who is married to the dashing Emperor Sovieshu ( Ju Ji-hoon ). Their alliance unravels when Sovieshu brings a runaway slave (Lee Se-young) into the palace as his mistress.
